Reject categorical covariates with implausibly many levels

check_cat_covs_levels.Rd

Each categorical covariate is imputed with a (multinomial) logistic regression, whose cost grows quickly with the number of levels. A categorical covariate with hundreds of levels is almost always a continuous column (e.g. a time or dose counter) passed in cat_covs by mistake, and would make the sampler run for hours without any output. Covariates listed in cat_covs, as well as factor and character columns (which are always treated as categorical), are checked against max_cat_levels.

Usage

check_cat_covs_levels(data, covs, cat_covs = NULL, max_cat_levels = 20)

Arguments

data

data.frame with covariates

covs

names of the covariates to check

cat_covs

names of the covariates declared categorical

max_cat_levels

maximum number of distinct (non-missing) values allowed for a categorical covariate. Inf disables the check.

Value

named integer vector with the number of levels of each categorical covariate, invisibly
